contributions.anchor: Summary line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (See Schedule A)', COLUMN A 'Total this Period' = 7,400.79 on the p4 Summary Page — the promoted per-period cell on the legacy_colAB form. Schedule A's OWN two printed footers ('Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)') are BOTH WHOLLY BLANK, so Column A line 1 is the side's ONLY anchor and that is said loudly here.
contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries exactly ONE written entry, on printed row 1: 1/9/26 'Previous Campaign Funds' 7,400.79. It equals Column A line 1 (7,400.79) to the cent, so the side closes exactly on its only anchor. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is BLANK on every line of this filing, so no cumulative figure exists and none was synthesized; nothing was differenced across covers. || THE FILER DOUBLE-BOOKS THIS ONE FIGURE AND HIS OWN LADDER DOES NOT CLOSE — recorded, NOT adjudicated (CLAUDE.md 'do not adjudicate a filer's own inconsistency'). Line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' ALSO prints 7,400.79, and line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' prints 7,400.79 again, yet line 5 'Subtotal (Add lines 3 and 4)' prints 7,400.79 rather than 14,801.58 — i.e. he entered the money in both slots but added it only once. Lines 6 (5,630.11) and 7 (1,770.68 = 7,400.79 - 5,630.11) then follow correctly from line 5. THE LADDER TEST OF ADDENDUM B3/N4 IS THEREFORE SELF-CONTRADICTORY HERE, and the tie is broken by what the document itself states about Schedule A: line 1 is captioned '(See Schedule A)' and equals this row exactly, so the row is published as the one row Schedule A reports (the ADDENDUM D4 precedent), flagged needs_review=1, with the carry-forward character of the money spelled out in its note. Nothing was merged, netted or recomputed.

expenditures.anchor: Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' = 5,630.11 AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' = 5,630.11, which is also Summary line 2 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (See Schedule B)' COLUMN A 'Total this Period' = 5,630.11 and line 6 = 5,630.11. Four printed statements of the same period-scoped figure agree.
expenditures.detail: The 17 Schedule B rows on p3 sum to 69.00 + 3.95 + 901.50 + 722.46 + 291.14 + 170.00 + 24.15 + 500.00 + 868.40 + 146.35 + 130.70 + 295.00 + 20.03 + 24.70 + 172.90 + 780.83 + 509.00 = 5,630.11 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed sum-of-all-pages total = Column A line 2. Single schedule sheet, so both footers share a scope; both were read rather than trusted on their captions (ADDENDUM N3 screen — neither holds a cycle figure, and there is no cumulative figure on this filing at all). || ROW 3 IS 901.50 AND NOT 900.50, AND THAT READING IS THE PAGE'S OWN, NOT AN ADJUSTMENT. Read at 200 dpi the cell looks like '900.50' with a blot; at 2000 dpi the third character is unmistakably the filer's LIGHT BLUE OVAL '0' with a HEAVY DARK-BLUE '1' WRITTEN OVER IT — a handwritten correction, which governs (CHUNK_BRIEF section 7). The corrected reading is confirmed twice over, exactly the ADDENDUM F6 standard: (a) the whole amount column was re-rendered at 900 dpi in two halves and all 17 cells are unambiguous EXCEPT this one, so the page carries exactly one doubtful cell and the attribution is unique from the page alone; (b) 901.50 closes the sheet to the cent on its own printed subtotal, while 900.50 leaves it 1.00 short; and (c) the overwriting stroke matches this filer's own unambiguous '1' elsewhere on the page (the leading 1s of 146.35, 172.90 and the middle 1 of 291.14 — a downstroke with a small top-left entry flag) and does not match his clean oval '0' (69.00, 170.00, 500.00). NO FIGURE WAS NUDGED: the struck value was not published because the page itself supersedes it.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closes both sides exactly. BOTH conventions were tested per ADDENDUM G1/O4: this legacy county-only blank prints no in-kind column or checkbox on either schedule, no row is annotated in-kind or as a gift or donated service, and no amount appears on both schedules, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give identical sums (7,400.79 and 5,630.11) and both close. in_kind=false throughout is read off the page, not defaulted.
itemized.escalation_note: Eight tight-crop escalations. The decisive one: p3 row 3's dollars field at 2000 dpi (pct:84.2,25.2,5.5,3.3@p3), which resolved the blot into a light '0' overwritten by a heavy '1' and settled the cell at 901.50 (see recon.expenditures.detail). Supporting: the whole p3 amount column re-rendered at 900 dpi in two halves (pct:82.8,16.4,12.8,34.4@p3 and pct:82.8,50.8,12.8,34.3@p3), which confirmed the other 16 amounts and established that row 3 is the page's ONLY doubtful cell; the p3 date column in two halves at 700 dpi, confirming all 17 dates; p3 row-1 (rendered '69.00') and row-17 (rendered '509.00') proof crops at 900 dpi plus the outside-the-grid control (rendered the printed subtotal '5,630.11'); p2 row-1 at 900 dpi (rendered '7,400.79') with its one-band-past control (rendered EMPTY) and a full-width row-1 strip at 500 dpi; and the p4 line-1 Column A cell at 1200 dpi, which showed a short scribbled-out entry struck through with a long diagonal, LEFT UNTRANSCRIBED because it is genuinely illegible and never guessed.
